question: Can the retained MLP response factors be generated from small, cross-panel residual-input subspaces derived directly from Left/Right/Down weights?

frozen_program.authority: the v1 factor-pruned causal program and its two frozen response-projector fits
frozen_program.effective_covector: A(x_base)=W_Left^T diag(Right(x_base)) W_Down^T Q + W_Right^T diag(Left(x_base)) W_Down^T Q
frozen_program.crossfit: even projector: fit each MLP input basis on A1 and evaluate A2; odd projector: fit on A2 and evaluate A1
frozen_program.causal_arms: exact retained attention factors plus MLP factors generated through each frozen input-covector rank
frozen_program.controls: temporal-v11 P rows, using only target-fit covector bases

predictions.pred_a_authority_hash_exact_effective_co: authorities replay and the uncompressed effective-covector contraction reproduces every retained MLP coordinate at RSE <=1e-10
predictions.pred_b_rank32_crosspanel_coefficient_pre: rank-32 heldout coefficient RSE is <=0.10 for every MLP site, task, and projector fit
predictions.pred_c_rank32_compiled_program_is_target: for both projector fits, the rank-32 compiled program has worst heldout target residual <=0.15 and signed behavior projection >=0.80 per task
predictions.pred_d_rank32_compiled_program_is_select: rank-32 temporal controls have margin RMS <=0.10 of target scale, median full-vocabulary KL <=0.02 nat, and top-1 flip fraction <=0.05
predictions.pred_e_weight_covectors_admit_material_l: rank 32 captures >=90% of training effective-covector energy at every MLP site and reduces mean heldout coefficient RSE by >=10% relative to rank 8 for both fits

decision: Passing compiles the MLP coefficient generators one causal level upstream into fixed residual-input coordinates. Failure localizes whether gate-conditioned weight covectors require more rank or fail cross-panel transfer; it does not invalidate the already-passing factor-pruned response circuit.
